entries.message: Feature - Rename the app to Plekt
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Rename the app to Plekt
Feature: New Plekt wordmark in the sidebar, sign-in, setup and About pages, in dark and light, with the old logo's heavier lettering and diagonal cut
Feature: New app icon for the browser tab, home screen and Windows, with a dark background that fills the icon on phones
Feature: New icon for the app's own entries in watch rows and Force Sync
Feature: The app, sign-in, setup, About pages and browser tab now say Plekt throughout
Feature: Settings given as PLEMBFIN_ environment variables keep working, and the same settings can use PLEKT_ names
Feature: Webhooks accept the secret in an X-Plekt-Webhook-Secret header as well as the older X-Plembfin-Webhook-Secret header
Feature: New backups are named plekt-backup and plekt-watch-history; backups made earlier still restore, still appear in lists and still count toward retention
Feature: Remote backup retention orders files by the date in their name, so older-named files are removed first
Feature: New installs store data in plekt.db; an existing plembfin.db is kept and used
Feature: Docker images publish under the plekt name, and the old plembfin image name keeps receiving releases with an in-app notice about the change
Feature: The Windows installer moves an existing Plembfin service and data folder to the Plekt names
Feature: The default published port moves from 5055 to 5056 (set with PLEKT_PUBLISHED_PORT), and a banner warns when a Jellyfin webhook still targets the old port
Feature: In-app help links point to plekt.net
Feature: Audit history payloads are size-limited so the database grows more slowly, and unexpected process errors are handled more safely

entries.message: This update refreshes dashboard data on entry and moves Plembfin's default port to 5056 so it can run alongside Seerr.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Refresh dashboard data and avoid Seerr port conflict
Fix: Refresh watch history and Up Next when the dashboard opens, showing loading or unavailable feedback until fresh server data arrives.
Fix: Use port 5056 as Plembfin's default so it can run alongside Seerr on 5055; Docker still listens internally on 5055.

entries.message: Improve sync recovery and backup controls, harden artwork caching, and add configurable Windows ports.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Choose a dashboard port during Windows installation or upgrade, with the setting applied to the service, tray, shortcuts, and optional firewall rule.
Fix: Use SHA-256 poster-cache IDs and re-key existing cache rows without losing stored artwork.
Fix: Check SQLite integrity before a full restore and explain recovery options when the database is corrupt.
Fix: Refresh Resume and Up Next after focus or connectivity returns, and sort resume cards by the latest parsed progress update.
Fix: Retry an episode mutation once after refreshing stale series indexes for Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin.
Fix: Show the final provider reason when a destination is skipped in Sync Activity.
Fix: Start media details at the top of their scroll area.
Tweak: Set separate retention periods for local and remote full backups.
Tweak: Default backup retention to seven days.
